_note: The turning earth (sim/earth.gd): fixed ground that turns at age-ups (Yusuf, 2026-11-06, simplifying the earth as this round's weather of 2026-10-25). Just past the still town lies one ring of plates (rings: r0 to r1 from the hearth, plates of them, cuts staggered a little), each plate of a kind from near_kinds, dealt one each per run in a seeded order. The ground stays put while the town is in one age; when the town ages up the ring clicks round the hearth by one whole plate as the next round begins (dir 1 clockwise on screen, -1 the other way). Only the kinds move: nodes, dens, trails and people stay where they are. The night's attack crosses one plate on its way in from its den, and the threat card names that plate's kind in one line. Per kind: walk = how fast anyone walks over it (x), raider_walk = how fast raiders walk over it (x, on top of walk), sight = how far the hearth and towers see raiders standing on it (x their range), regrow = share of full that plant-tagged nodes on it regrow each dawn, rise_chance = chance a raider who falls on it gets up again once at rise_hp of its health, grave_goods = chance a hero who kills a raider on it digs up an item; tags = what relics and buildings key on (plate_knobs); gives and takes = the plate's hover, short = the threat card's few words. enabled = false keeps the earth still (for tests that need a fixed map). colors = the map's tint for each kind, and edge for the faint lines round the plates. route_looks = how the red line of tonight's attack (game/raider_route.gd) looks where it crosses a plate of each kind: color and line (wave, dots, chevrons or crosses); open country is plain.

fen.name: Fen
fen.gives: Raiders wade at 70% speed, so the hearth and towers get more shots.
fen.takes: Your gatherers wade through it too.
fen.short: raiders wade slowly under your towers

greenwood.name: Greenwood
greenwood.gives: Groves and berries on it regrow each dawn.
greenwood.takes: Raiders come out of cover close to town: the hearth and towers see them at 60% of their range.
greenwood.short: raiders come out of cover close to town

stonefield.name: Stonefield
stonefield.gives: Open ground: the hearth and towers see raiders on it from a quarter further off.
stonefield.takes: Hard ground: raiders march over it 20% faster.
stonefield.short: open ground, but raiders march fast

barrow.name: Gravefield
barrow.gives: A hero who kills a raider on it may dig up grave goods (an item).
barrow.takes: A raider who falls on it may get up again, once.
barrow.short: the fallen may get up again
